comments.author: @Elhad57
comments.text: I'm from Mayotte, and that's not Mayotte—it's “the Comoros”; plus, you're relying too much on AI, so the video makes no sense and isn't interesting...

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: We want to clarify that our footage is captured on location by cinematographers and not generated by AI, though we regret that this documentary did not resonate with your experience.

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: The tropical scenery is beautiful, but the human side stayed with me more. Living on a small island where African and French identities meet must create a fascinating rhythm of everyday life.

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: We’re so glad the human stories behind that beautiful scenery resonated with you. ✨
